title: Dot on the Log
learning_objectives: Decode CVC words with short o
Read mixed short-a, short-i and short-o words in one story
parent_prompts: New sound: short o as in dog, log, hop. Stretch it: d-o-g.
This story mixes a, i and o words. If the child swaps a vowel (dig for dog), point to the middle letter.
After reading: Why did Dot hop off the log? Who was on it?

pages.text: Dot is a dog. Dot naps on a big log.
pages.illustration_brief: A small spotted dog lying on a thick fallen log by a pond; keep the frog hidden.
pages.audio_script: Dot is a dog. Dot naps on a big log.

pages.text: Hop! A frog is on the log.
pages.illustration_brief: A green frog mid-hop landing on the far end of the log; Dot's eye opening.
pages.audio_script: Hop! A frog is on the log.

pages.text: Dot sits up. The frog hops to a rock.
pages.illustration_brief: Dot sitting up alert; the frog on a grey rock in the pond.
pages.audio_script: Dot sits up. The frog hops to a rock.

pages.text: Dot hops to the rock. The frog hops to a pot.
pages.illustration_brief: Dot balancing on the rock; the frog now on an upturned clay pot on the bank.
pages.audio_script: Dot hops to the rock. The frog hops to a pot.

pages.text: Dot hops to the pot. Tip! Dot is in the pond. Dot is wet.
pages.illustration_brief: The pot tipped over; Dot splashing in shallow water, surprised; frog on the log again.
pages.audio_script: Dot hops to the pot. Tip! Dot is in the pond. Dot is wet.

pages.text: The frog sits on the log. Dot sits in the mud. "Rib-bit," said the frog.
pages.illustration_brief: Frog calm on the log; muddy Dot sitting below looking up at it.
pages.audio_script: The frog sits on the log. Dot sits in the mud. Rib-bit, said the frog.

quiz.explanation: l-o-g. The middle sound is short o and the last sound is g.

quiz.prompt: Where does the frog hop right after the rock?
quiz.explanation: Page 3: the frog hops to a rock. Page 4: the frog hops to a pot.

quiz.prompt: Why does Dot end up in the pond?

options.text: The pot tips when Dot hops on it

quiz.explanation: Page 5: Dot hops to the pot. Tip! Dot is in the pond.

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up where the frog went and where Dot ended up.
quiz.rubric: not yet: says dog or frog only; with support: two places with prompting; independent: log, rock, pot in order and Dot fell in the pond
quiz.explanation: Tracking the chase in order shows the child read the words, not the pictures.

items.text: The frog hops on the log.
The frog hops to a rock.
The frog hops to a pot.

activities.prompt: Match the words that have the same middle sound.

off_screen_prompt: Hop like a frog to three places in the room. Say where you land: rug, mat, box...

review.decodability_note: Short-o CVC: Dot, dog, log, hop(s), pot, on; short-i: sit(s), in, tip; short-a: nap(s). Words beyond the three taught patterns are placed on the irregular list so the parent introduces them first: frog, pond (blends), rock (ck), big, wet, mud, up (other short vowels), rib-bit, said, up. Step 7 (mixed review) may retire most of these.
